# Manumit

> Independent software studio building completely free, privacy-first apps.
> Name means "to set free" — freeing users from paywalls, ads, and tracking.

## Who we are

- Studio: Manumit — https://manumit.studio/
- Founder: Cedric Landua (solo independent developer) — https://cedric-landua.pages.dev/
- Contact: freeerapps.dev@gmail.com (human replies, no bots)
- Support: https://manumit.studio/help/ (ticket form: support, bugs, other)
- Promise: Quality. Private. Free.

## What we do

- Free Software Development: every app completely unlocked, $0 forever
- Privacy-First App Design: zero tracking, no ads, no paywalls, deletable anytime
- Encrypted Cloud Sync: optional, end-to-end encrypted, works offline-first
- Productivity Apps: task management, planning, focus tools
- User Interface Design: clean, human-reviewed, accessible
- Cross-Platform App Development: web + Android (Capacitor), Cloudflare stack

## Products

- [Split Task](https://manumit.studio/products/split-task/): break big goals into small steps. Free planner with auto-splitting, encrypted sync, offline support. Live app: https://manumit.studio/products/split-task/app/
- All products: https://manumit.studio/products/

## Key pages

- Home: https://manumit.studio/
- Products: https://manumit.studio/products/
- Help & Support: https://manumit.studio/help/
- Policies: https://manumit.studio/policies/ (Privacy + EULA)

## Principles

1. No paywalls — every feature free, no premium tiers
2. Your data stays yours — zero tracking, optional encrypted sync
3. Quality is not negotiable — free software outperforming paid alternatives
4. Made for everyone — accessible, human-supported

## Tech

Cloudflare Pages + Workers + D1, offline-first, content-hashed static shell.
